entity.name: Terexitarius Stomp
entity.description: Independent developer building atproto-native, client-first infrastructure on Cloudflare's edge. delta-git is maintained as a public good: a code forge whose identity, keys, and data live with users, not with a host.

projects.name: delta-git
projects.description: An atproto-native, client-first code forge running on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1, KV, and R2. Git Smart HTTP v2, DID-based authentication, client-side key custody (no secrets hosted), hash-chained op-log provenance, agent-native APIs, and forge-verified contribution attestations. Live at code.widespread.fyi.

channels.description: Recurring or one-time sponsorship via GitHub Sponsors.
Donations and grant invoicing via Open Collective (fiscal host pending).
Streaming support via Drips (Radicle ecosystem); delta-git is also canonical on Radicle.

plans.name: Sustaining maintenance
plans.description: Recurring support for maintenance, security response, and review bandwidth on delta-git.

plans.name: Forge development grant
plans.description: One-time or milestone funding toward roadmap items: never-reject push resolution, client-side encrypted private repos, adjudication/quorum, federation mirror-out, and self-host deployability.
